title: Before you build one, ask four questions.
kit: Before you build one, ask four questions.
Ask your IT team first. Then build small.
License: does your Microsoft 365 account include Power Automate?
Permission: does your IT team allow these connectors?
Owner: who fixes it when it breaks, or when someone leaves?
People: is every approval still made by a person?

title: Why not Copilot or an agent?
kit: Why not Copilot or an agent?
A flow moves work between people. It never replaces their decisions.
It starts on its own when a form arrives. Copilot and agents wait to be asked.
It waits for an approval, for days if needed, then continues.
It writes the log and sends the email the same way every time.
It decides nothing. The manager approves; the flow carries the request.
